All cell indices are in canonical q×r flat order (see docs/GRID_ORDERING_v2.md). active_cells values must be inscribable (hex distance ≤ 8 from center, i.e. max(|q|,|r|,|q+r|) ≤ 8); valid indices range from 62 to 406 but are NOT contiguous. Center (0,0) = index 234. Element indices: 0=neutral, 1=fire, 2=air, 3=water, 4=earth. border_activations order: [fire=0, air=1, water=2, earth=3].
